changelog:
## 1.0

First Apps Catalog release.

- MCW (FM tone), CW (OOK) and SSB (USB/LSB) keying modes
- Repeater-style activity trigger, fixed-interval trigger, or both, with
  start-of-TX / end-of-TX interval anchoring
- Remote text over BLE serial or UART (pins 13/14)
- PARIS-standard timing with ARRL Farnsworth spacing
- Station ID log, capped at 256 KB with rotation
description:
Keys Morse code out of the CC1101: a station ID beacon and a remote text keyer.

## Beacon triggers
- **On activity**: IDs after the first transmission that follows a configurable stretch of dead air, the way a repeater controller does.
- **Interval**: keys the ID on a fixed schedule for fox hunts and plain beacons, with the period measured start-to-start or end-to-start.

## Keying modes
- **MCW**: an audible tone on an FM carrier - what an FM handheld hears
- **CW (OOK)**: true carrier keying, for AM/CW detectors and BFO receivers
- **SSB (USB/LSB)**: the carrier offset by the tone pitch, so an SSB receiver on the dial frequency hears the beat note

## Remote text
Send a line from a phone over BLE serial, or from anything wired to UART pins 13/14, and it is keyed on air. Speed 5-40 wpm with PARIS-standard timing and ARRL Farnsworth spacing.

Transmit permission is decided by the firmware's region policy: the app asks before keying and logs a refusal instead of working around it. Every ID is written to a timestamped log, capped at 256 KB with rotation.
